text:
Aisha: :rotating_light: Observability alert — inference-slo-anomaly triggered for eu-west1. Sudden 5xx increase + p95 latency spike. Starting internal ops thread.
SRE Bot: PagerDuty incident 73217 created for group inference-runtime. Escalation policy: primary -> secondary.
PagerDuty: Paging Aisha (primary on-call).
Aisha: I'm on it, joining now. Any initial scope notes?
Devon: I'm checking router and model-serving pods. No OOMs in pod logs so far. Seeing CPU & network queue growth on gpu-nodes-3.
Marco: I'll take Incident Lead. Creating ops-room: https://meet.redwood/inference-ops/51789 (ops access only) :link: 
Imogen: Assigning mitigation owner to Devon. Do we want a customer-facing note now or wait for root cause?
statuspage-bot: Draft status created: "Degraded performance for inference API in eu-west1. Engineers investigating." Link: https://status.redwood/drafts/incident-73217
Marco: Quick runbook to follow: 1) Verify KV cache health and hit rates; 2) Check autoscale/backlog; 3) Consider routing to model-v2.2 fallback if needed. Devon, start step 1.
Devon: Running checks. Commands I'm running: 
```bash
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep inference-runtime
kubectl -n inference logs inference-runtime-12 --tail=200 | sed -n '1,200p'
```
Aisha: Alert spike time aligns with 2026-03-17T12:42:00Z. Customer impact: intermittent 503s, roughly estimated at ~10% of eu-west traffic based on sampling.
Imogen: Draft customer note suggestion:
"We're investigating increased errors and latency in eu-west1 affecting a subset of requests. Our engineers are actively mitigating and will provide updates every 15 minutes."
Marco: Set update cadence to 15m. Devon, coordinate cache actions with DB ops before any destructive cache purges.
Devon: Looking at Redis metrics — cache hit rate down to ~12% on shard redis-eu-west-3. Preparing targeted prefix purge for recent model variant.
Aisha: Pager confirmation: PagerDuty acknowledged (Aisha). Looping in DB ops (cc @Imogen).
Imogen: On it — contacting DB ops to get ready for possible coordinated purge.
statuspage-bot: Update published: "Investigating — Degraded performance in eu-west1. Engineers are investigating. Next update in ~15 minutes."
Marco: If purge doesn't help within next 10m, fallback plan: route traffic from model-v2.4 to model-v2.2 via infra route override (infra repo PR ready). Devon, be ready to trigger.
Devon: Targeted purge executed: `redis-cli -h redis-eu-west-3 EVAL "..." 0` — cache hit rate rising to ~48% on gpu-3, latency trending down on sampled requests. Monitoring closely.
Aisha: Observability shows error rate dropping from peak ~12% -> 3.5% in last 4 minutes. Good signal.
Marco: Assigning post-incident writeup owner: Imogen. Please capture timeline + decisions.
Imogen: Will do. I'll start a running timeline doc and capture commands + dashboards.
Aisha: Anyone seeing anomalies in rerank/reroute pipeline? :eyes:
Devon: No anomalies in rerank logs. Seems isolated to inference runtime path and cache state.
Imogen: DB ops reports nothing unusual on the DB side. Cache purge looks to be the effective mitigation.
Marco: OK — keep monitoring. If stable for 30m, we'll move to recovery->monitoring state and push a resolved update.
Aisha: Preparing next customer update template for 12:57 UTC cycle.
Devon: Cache steady, latency within SLO band for now. I'll keep sampling and report any regressions.
Aisha: Thanks team. Ops-room will stay open; closing note to be sent after 30m stable window. :thumbsup:
